class.name: DV_DetailPanel
class.brief_description: Flexible key-value inspector for presenting grouped records and interactive forms.
class.description:
DV_DetailPanel renders a stacked list of [DV_Field] entries. It supports two modes: **Display Mode** (labels, badges, and progress bars) and **Interactive Mode** (LineEdits, Sliders, Checkboxes, and Dropdowns).
The panel automatically handles layout, grouping, and signal routing. Use it for character sheets, world settings, or complex data entry forms. When the fields do not fit, the panel scrolls: a vertical scrollbar appears and the mouse wheel moves it. Content is clipped to the panel's frame, so a long list never draws over what sits below it.

tutorials.link:
[codeblocks] [gdscript] extends DV_DetailPanel
func _ready() -> void: set_title("World Settings")
# 1. Text Input var world_name := DV_Field.new() world_name.label = "Server Name" world_name.key = "srv_name" world_name.set_control_type(DV_Field.TYPE_INPUT) add_field(world_name)
# 2. Slider with Auto-Readout var volume := DV_Field.new() volume.label = "Ambient Volume" volume.key = "vol_ambient" volume.set_control_type(DV_Field.TYPE_SLIDER) volume.min_value = 0 volume.max_value = 100 volume.value = 50 add_field(volume)
# 3. ComboList / Dropdown var region := DV_Field.new() region.label = "Region" region.key = "srv_region" region.set_control_type(DV_Field.TYPE_DROPDOWN) region.list_values = ["North America", "Europe", "Asia"] add_field(region)
data_changed.connect(_on_data_changed)
func _on_data_changed(key: String, value: Variant, field: DV_Field): print("Setting Updated: ", key, " -> ", value) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_field_count
method.description: How many fields the panel currently holds.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every field and frees any inline editor widgets the panel created. Call this before repopulating so editors are not left behind.

method.name: add_field
method.description: Appends a [DV_Field] to the panel. Fields are grouped and rendered in insertion order.

method.name: get_row_count
method.description: Returns the number of visible rows, including group headers when enabled.

method.name: get_selected_row
method.description: Returns the selected row index. -1 if none selected.

method.name: get_row_rect
method.description: Provides the screen-space rectangle for a row, useful for custom overlays or hit testing.

method.name: set_group_gap
method.description: Sets the extra vertical spacing before new group headers (in pixels).

method.name: set_label_width
method.description: Manually assigns the width of the label column. Disable [member auto_label_width] to use it.

method.name: set_row_gap
method.description: Adjusts the spacing between consecutive rows (in pixels).

method.name: set_show_group_headers
method.description: Toggles rendering of group header labels above clustered fields.

method.name: set_wrap_values
method.description: Enables or disables multi-line wrapping for value text.

members.member: Header text displayed above the detail panel content.
Index of the selected row, or [code]-1[/code]. Read-only; selection follows clicks.

signal.name: row_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when a row is clicked. Includes both the display label and the field's stable key.

signal.name: value_changed
signal.description: Emitted when an interactive control (LineEdit, Slider, etc.) modifies the field's value.
